Messages.Author: Joe Helfrich
Messages.Body:
Well, when WOTC stopped actively supporting Jyhad, I stopped playing. But I
wisely held on to all my cards, sitting on a corner of the floor waiting
patiently as my Star Wars CCG collection grew and grew.

But with White Wolf picking up the license, I find myself wondering....

So here I am again. Been lurking for a while, but with little Sabbat, it's
tough to understand some of the rules questions. Is there a site with spoiler
lists? Strategy articles? Anybody play in Denver? Is JOL still around?
Maybe they can run a beginner's game?

Certainly glad to see LSJ still in control... ;)

Joe
